drop.title: Drop an audio file
drop.subtitle: MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC · nothing is uploaded, ever

trim.hint: Drag the handles on the waveform or type exact times.

volume.hint: Boost or cut the level. Above 0 dB peak the output will clip.
volume.clipWarning: This gain pushes peaks above 0 dB. Expect clipping, or enable Normalize.

fade.hint: Linear ramps at the start and end of the output.

speed.hint: Pitch changes with speed. Pitch-preserving stretch is not available on-device yet.

normalize.enableHint: Bring the clip to a consistent level

merge.hint: Clips are joined end to end in this order. Trim, gain, fades and speed apply to the merged result.
merge.needMore: Add at least one more clip to merge.

convert.bitrateHint: Higher bitrate, larger file. 192 kbps is transparent for most music.
convert.wavHint: WAV is uncompressed PCM — no quality loss, large files.
convert.ffmpegNote: MP3, OGG and M4A use an on-device encoder (about 30 MB, downloaded once and cached).

status.decodeErrorBody: This file couldn't be decoded. Try MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A or FLAC.
status.encoderError: The on-device encoder failed to load. Check your connection and try again, or export as WAV.
status.processedIn: Processed on this device in {seconds} s

recorder.title: Voice recorder
recorder.subtitle: Records from your microphone. Audio stays in this tab until you download it.
recorder.denied: Microphone access was denied. Check your browser's site permissions.
recorder.unsupported: Recording isn't supported in this browser.
